follow_up_gaps.description: All record-based finding detail pages should provide consistent actions 'Von Analyse ausschließen' and 'Als korrigiert markieren' and allow drilldown to the original Business Central record. Some pages currently expose the actions, others require manual DH Exception creation, and some custom lists do not open the underlying record.

A record marked 'Als korrigiert markieren' does not appear in the DH Exceptions list. Verify intended data model, persistence across scans/upgrades, UI visibility, and whether corrected state should affect scoring until the next scan.

With Monitoring Monatsabo valid until 07.09.2026 23:59, the setup field 'Produktzugriff bis' still shows the prior 7-day Full Analysis date 14.08.2026 13:27:44. The field must reflect the effective monitoring entitlement.

known_defects_carried_forward.description: Free plan exposes financial impact and finding drilldown. Must be fixed before 50-customer go-live.
Setup and history require a manual page refresh to display a completed background scan.

decision: PARTIAL_PASS - CORE UPGRADE, DH EXCEPTION PRESERVATION, SCAN HISTORY PRESERVATION, MANUAL MONITORING AND SCHEDULED MONITORING ARE VERIFIED. FINAL PASS REQUIRES EXPLICIT SINGLE JOB-QUEUE CHECK AND CLARIFICATION/TEST OF CORRECTED-RECORD STATE. PRODUCT-ACCESS-UNTIL DATE IS A CONFIRMED P1 DEFECT BUT DOES NOT INVALIDATE THE UPGRADE PATH ITSELF.
